name: playwright-artillery-js
description: Playwright JS framework (POM) for OrangeHRM demo, with .claude skills/rules-driven test authoring and native HTML reporting.

scripts.artillery:load: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('artillery-output', { recursive: true });" && artillery run -o artillery-output/load-suite.json artillery/load-suite.yml
scripts.artillery:quick: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('artillery-output', { recursive: true });" && artillery run -o artillery-output/quick-smoke.json artillery/quick-smoke.yml
